Name: (CP) Dustbeauty's Stardew Foliage and Recolor
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/Q3GLq5J.gif[/img]﻿

To put it simply, this is a compatible version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]original mod[/url]. Permissions can be checked [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/9139916]here[/url]. The original did not have mossy versions, so I have added some moss versions for the wild trees![b] PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS IS A RECOLOR MOD WITH FOLIAGE. 
[/b]Additional Info: The original mod is foliage only but I took this opportunity to learn and extend it for a map recolor (+ foliage).

[color=#f4f4f4][b]For troubleshooting[/b], this is what I can recommend if you find issues:
[/color][color=#f4f4f4]1. If you have many mods, try to isolate the mod and test if it is working. If it does, then a mod that you have causes the issue. 
2. If you have isolated the mod and confirm that it really is not working, please go to  [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi log[/url] and copy-paste the URL in the bugs section.
3. Additionally, if it is a visual bug, it is a bonus for me if you can include an image via [url=https://imgur.com/]imgur [/url]﻿and copy-paste the URL. 

[/color][i][color=#f4cccc]Isolating the mod [/color][/i]means creating a temporary farm for testing while only keeping this mod and its requirements in the Mods folder.

[b]Version 2.0 has the following:[/b] 
♥ fixed, added and improved tilesheets
♥ added mossy versions
♥ added configurations for GCMC [i]done[/i]
♥ improved town's grass and dirt to match farm

[b]For installation[/b]:
1. Download the mod and its requirements 
2. Extract and put it inside your Mods folder
3. Launch the game


[img]https://imgur.com/OLvmpZI.gif[/img]

Incredible thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/9139916]Dustbeauty[/url]! I love her mods so much and it's been the first ones I use when I first played the game with mods.
To my ever kind, patient, and thorough testers [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FermcelAlex/about-me]FermcelAlex [/url]﻿and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/huliganka696/about-me]huliganka696[/url], thank you for your support and contribution. Please give them your kudos! Without them, testing alone would have taken me another week.
